scope: Three live pocket switches and their startup configuration

dynamic_behavior.disable: blocks pending triggers; does not restore pocketed balls
dynamic_behavior.persistence: live session only; startup state remains in the root tool config

preview_api_effects: Returns a fresh array of eligible ball references from the supplied table; does not mutate balls, results or arrays.

deployment.coordinator: Other chat maintaining bank_physics.js performs the final combined build, install and apply.

limitations: No live sweep gameplay or server-acceptance validation was performed.
Physics module integration of previewPocketCandidates is owned by the coordinating chat; the read-only API is ready.
